_comment: Removed both abilities. The ON_HIT set BLANCH_FLAG, a flag nothing reads, and the second was a plain STATIC applying MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE -1 -- a defence penalty found nowhere in the card's text. NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'cards they own lose all colors until the end of their next turn'. Colour drives pitch value and every colour-gated condition in the corpus; there is no mechanism for suppressing it, and a -1{d} standing in for it is not an approximation of anything.
